# Downloads / 下载

[Release downloads / 发布下载页](https://github.com/yzw641725631-boop/windows-php7-security-backports-for-PHP2Shell/releases/tag/php-7.4.33-php2shell-20261023-rc1)

## 中文

- `php-7.4.33-nts-Win32-VC15-x64-unofficial-upstream-backport-20261023.zip`：完整已编译 PHP 7.4.33 运行目录，Windows x64 / NTS / VC15，不含用户 `php.ini`。
- `phpStudy-PHP-7.4.33-nts-VC15-x64-unofficial-backport-install-kit-20261023.zip`：同一个运行包，加安装/备份/回滚脚本、双语说明和许可。
- `SHA256SUMS.txt`：ZIP 的 SHA-256，一致性校验不等于独立代码签名。

在 Release 的 Assets 里选择以上 ZIP；GitHub 自动生成的 Source code 是仓库快照。请先读[行为差异和验证限制](../README.md)，尤其是 OOM 工作进程退出及 Session 上传进度回调停用。

## English

The runtime ZIP is a complete compiled PHP 7.4.33 directory for Windows x64 NTS VC15, without user configuration. The phpStudy kit contains the same runtime plus installation/backup/rollback scripts and bilingual instructions. Compare downloads with `SHA256SUMS.txt`; hashes are not independent code signatures.

Choose the named ZIPs under Release Assets. GitHub's automatic Source code archives are repository snapshots. Read the [behavior and validation limits](../README.md), especially OOM worker exits and disabled Session upload progress.
